tools.description: Retrieves current weather for the given location.
tools.name: get_weather

alerts.description: Whether to include weather alerts. default false

aqi.description: Whether to include air quality index. default false

date.description: Start date for the weather forecast. format: YYYY-MM-DD. If omitted, defaults to today.

days.description: Number of days to forecast. default 1. If date is provided, forecast starts from that date; otherwise starts from today.

language.description: Language code for the weather description text. Supported values: zh-Hans (Simplified Chinese), en, ja, fr, de, es, it. Defaults to en when omitted or unsupported.

location.description: City and country e.g. Bogotá, Colombia

max_results.description: Maximum number of emails to retrieve

query.description: Gmail filter query (e.g. in:anywhere|archive|important|starred|sent|unread|read, after:1388552400, before:1391230800, after:2014/01/01, before:2014/02/01, newer_than:7d, older_than:1m, subject:report) , invalid query: after:2026/03/31 12:00(hour is not supported), label:SENT(should use in:sent)

location.description: Geographic location for localised search results (e.g. "New York, NY")

time_range.description: Time range filter (e.g. "d" = past day, "w" = past week, "m" = past month, "y" = past year)

tools.description: Send a message to a Slack channel, group, or DM. Or send thread replies and direct messages by user ID. Either channel_id or to_user_id must be provided.
tools.name: slack_send_message

blocks.description: Optional: Block Kit blocks as JSON array string

channel_id.description: Target conversation ID (channel / group / DM). Required if to_user_id is not provided

channel_name.description: Optional: target channel name (for error messages only, not used for sending)

reply_broadcast.description: Optional: also post thread reply to the channel (default false)

thread_ts.description: Optional: parent message ts to reply in a thread. Requires channel_id to be set

to_user_id.description: Slack user ID to open a DM with. Required if channel_id is not provided

to_user_name.description: Optional: target user name (for error messages only, not used for sending)

user_id.description: User ID (numeric) who sends the message

tools.description: Send the same message to multiple Slack targets in one call. At least one of channel_ids or to_user_ids must be provided. Total targets (channel_ids + to_user_ids) max 5.
tools.name: slack_batch_send_message

blocks.description: Optional: Block Kit blocks as JSON array string

channel_ids.description: Comma-separated conversation IDs (channels / groups / DMs). Required if to_user_ids is not provided

channel_names.description: Optional: target channel names (for error messages only, not used for sending)

to_user_ids.description: Comma-separated Slack user IDs to open DMs with. Required if channel_ids is not provided

to_user_names.description: Optional: target user names (for error messages only, not used for sending)

user_id.description: User ID (numeric) who sends the message

tools.description: List messages from a Slack conversation (channel / group / DM). Returns messages in reverse chronological order.
tools.name: slack_list_messages

cursor.description: Pagination cursor for next page. Format: an opaque string returned in the response_metadata.next_cursor field, e.g. 'dXNlcjpVMDYxTkZUVDI='

include_all_metadata.description: Optional: include all metadata for each message (default false)

latest.description: Optional: only messages before this time. Datetime string format, e.g. '2024-01-15', '2024-01-15 09:30:00', '2024-01-15 09:30'

limit.description: Maximum number of messages to return (default 20, max 1000)

oldest.description: Optional: only messages after this time. Datetime string format, e.g. '2024-01-15', '2024-01-15 09:30:00', '2024-01-15 09:30'

tools.description: Get all replies in a Slack message thread.
tools.name: slack_get_thread_replies

cursor.description: Pagination cursor for next page. Format: an opaque string returned in the response_metadata.next_cursor field, e.g. 'dXNlcjpVMDYxTkZUVDI='

limit.description: Maximum number of replies to return (default 20)

thread_ts.description: Parent message timestamp (ts) of the thread. A 16-digit Unix timestamp with 6 decimal places, e.g. '1716649200.123456'

tools.description: Search Slack messages by keyword. Supports filtering by channel and sender.
tools.name: slack_search_messages

after.description: Optional: only messages after this time. Use a datetime string

before.description: Optional: only messages before this time. Use a datetime string

channel_id.description: Optional: limit search to this channel

from_user_id.description: Optional: limit search to messages from this Slack user ID

has_file.description: Optional: only return messages with file attachments

has_link.description: Optional: only return messages with links

has_reaction.description: Optional: only return messages with reactions

types.description: Optional: comma-separated conversation types (public_channel, private_channel, mpim for group DMs, im for 1-on-1 DMs)

limit.description: Optional: maximum number of users to return per page

page_size.description: Max number of files to return (default 100, max 1000)

file_id.description: The ID of the file or folder

tools.description: Export a Google native file (Docs/Sheets/Slides) to a BINARY format such as application/pdf, .docx, .xlsx, .pptx, application/zip or application/epub+zip. Returns base64-encoded content, size limit 10MB. For reading text content (markdown/csv/plain), use read_drive_file instead.

file_id.description: The ID of the Google native file (Docs/Sheets/Slides)

mime_type.description: Target binary MIME type, e.g. application/pdf, application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document

tools.description: Search pages and databases the user has access to in Notion by keyword. Returns title, url and last updated time for each result.
tools.name: search_notion

filter_type.description: Only search a specific object type: 'page' or 'database'

tools.description: List all pages and databases the Notion integration has been granted access to, sorted by last edited time (newest first). Use this when the user asks what Notion content is authorized/available, or wants a browsable overview without a specific keyword.
tools.name: list_notion_accessible_items

filter_type.description: Only list a specific object type: 'page' or 'database' (optional)

tools.description: Get the full content of a Notion page as Markdown by page ID or URL. Long content is truncated with truncated=true.
tools.name: get_notion_page

max_length.description: Max body length in characters (0 = server default)

page_id.description: Notion page ID (either page_id or page_url is required)

page_url.description: Notion page URL (either page_id or page_url is required)

tools.description: Query items in a Notion database. The response includes the database schema (property names, types, options); filters MUST use real property names from the schema — call without filter first if unsure.
tools.name: query_notion_database

filter_json.description: Optional filter as JSON, supports and/or nesting. Example: {"and":[{"property":{"property":"Status","operator":"does_not_equal","value":"Done"}},{"property":{"property":"Due","operator":"on_or_after","value":"2026-07-01"}}]}. Operators: equals, does_not_equal, contains, does_not_contain, greater_than, less_than, on_or_before, on_or_after, before, after, is_empty, is_not_empty

sorts_json.description: Optional sorts as JSON array. Example: [{"property":"Due","direction":"ascending"}]

tools.description: Create a new Notion page under a parent page with Markdown content. Notion API does not allow creating pages at workspace root, so parent_page_id is required (use search_notion to find one).
tools.name: create_notion_page

icon.description: Page icon: an emoji or an image URL (optional)

tools.description: Create a new item (row) in a Notion database. Property names and types MUST match the database schema — call query_notion_database first to get the real schema.
tools.name: create_notion_database_item

properties_json.description: Item properties as JSON array matching the database schema. Example: [{"name":"Task","type":"title","values":["Write weekly report"]},{"name":"Status","type":"status","values":["In progress"]},{"name":"Due","type":"date","values":["2026-07-04"]}]

tools.description: Publish an AI-generated document (artifact) as a new Notion page, keeping title, body and source metadata. Returns the page URL. parent_page_id is required (use search_notion to find one).
tools.name: publish_artifact_to_notion

source.description: Source description, e.g. the conversation/task that generated it (optional)

tools.description: Append Markdown content to the end of an existing Notion page without modifying its current content.
tools.name: append_to_notion_page

tools.description: Create a draft for overwriting a Notion page's body. Pass the COMPLETE new Markdown body in new_markdown; returns a diff against the current page and a draft_id. Show the diff/summary to the user for confirmation, then call apply_notion_page_draft. Use append_to_notion_page instead when only adding content.
tools.name: update_notion_page_draft

new_markdown.description: The complete new page body in Markdown (will replace the current body when applied)

tools.description: Apply a draft created by update_notion_page_draft to actually overwrite the page body. Call this only after the user has confirmed the changes. Drafts expire after 30 minutes.
tools.name: apply_notion_page_draft
